model: AFFO-holding-period at cost of equity (REIT/property-trust row): 5-year attributable AFFO/dividend stream discounted at CoE, terminal value = exit P/B x projected NAV/share constrained to the observed 0.56-0.74 listed-history P/B band; cross-checked by direct Gordon capitalization of normalized attributable AFFO at CoE and by NAV-with-exit-discount. NOT an owner-FCF DCF.

inputs.share_count_basis: 146,138,526 ordinary shares per FY2025 annual report; held FLAT — buyback authorised but dormant (0 shares FY25); performance fee paid in shares (~0.26m shares/yr at NAV) and discretionary DRP are captured as a drag inside the NAV/share growth assumption, not double-charged via share count
inputs.net_debt_treatment: DISCLOSED ONLY — NOT deducted. AFFO is post-interest; capitalizing it at cost of equity already prices the $132.717m bank debt. Deducting net debt again would double-count it.
inputs.lp_units_treatment: Roc Partners' ~25% economic interest in the land-owning LP ($79.563m, non-current liability). Charged EXACTLY ONCE: valuation uses NZL-ATTRIBUTABLE AFFO of $7.932m (5.43 cps), not consolidated AFFO of $11.014m. NAV/share $1.6094 (net assets $235.198m) is ALREADY after the LP-unit liability, so the NAV cross-check does NOT deduct them a second time.
inputs.last_fcf_definition: FY2025 AFFO attributable to NZL shareholders (company AFFO reconciliation, FY2025 presentation p.9). Consolidated AFFO $11.014m less Land Trust (Roc) share $3.082m.
inputs.reported_fcf_warning: CSV FreeCashFlow is meaningless here: CapEx is land ACQUISITION (portfolio expansion), e.g. FY2021 -$120.7m, FY2022 -$90.7m, FY2023 -$65.4m. Not used.
inputs.net_income_warning: Reported NPAT dominated by unrealised IAS 40 revaluations (FY2022 $39.7m, FY2024 $24.9m NPAT on rent of $8.2m / $19.9m). NetIncome, EPS and NetMargin not used as earnings bases.
inputs.sbc_source: SBC-zero in the conventional sense; the analogous cost is the manager performance fee paid in NZL shares ($0.414m FY25, added back in AFFO as non-cash). Treated as real economic dilution inside the NAV/share growth assumption; house and street bases coincide.
inputs.interest_income_treatment: Left inside AFFO — it is recurring income on operating cash/loan receivables of the trust structure, and the company's AFFO definition already strips the non-cash capitalised interest ($1.412m FY25).
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-08-21T04:59:51Z (NZX regular close Fri 21 Aug; live ticker, non-null tail bars)
inputs.units: millions (per-share figures in NZD; AFFO paths in cents per share)
inputs.notes: Model: REIT/property-trust row of dcf-methods routing table — externally managed IAS 40 fair-value rural land owner-lessor. AFFO capitalized at COST OF EQUITY (post-interest flow; no net-debt subtraction). FY2021 is a ~9.5-month post-IPO stub and FY2022-6moStub a 6-month transition period (Jun->Dec year-end change): CAGRs spanning them are invalid. FY26 AFFO guidance $8.25-8.75m WITHDRAWN July 2026 after Kiwi Crunch Farms (Hawke's Bay orchard tenant, ~5.8% of LP rent) entered receivership with ~$0.3m arrears; a further ~7.3% of rent sits with related Wade Glass-linked Central Otago entities — ~13% of rent under a credit cloud, reflected in scenario design.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Rental income FY2023->FY2025 CAGR 20.5% vs NAV/share CAGR 0.2% and AFFO/share +9.9% — portfolio growth was acquisition-funded with new equity (115.6m -> 146.1m shares) and debt, so PER-SHARE accrual is far below portfolio growth. Model uses per-share growth only.
historical_growth.notes: 3yr/5yr revenue, EPS, equity and FCF CAGRs deliberately null: FY2021 IPO stub (~9.5 months, revenue $0.498m) and FY2022-6moStub transition period make them meaningless; EPS/NetIncome series is IAS 40 revaluation noise; CSV FCF series is land-acquisition noise. AFFO/share 3yr CAGR derived from company-stated +77.5% since FY22 (Dec-aligned, put/call-adjusted). Clean rental series: FY2023 $15.350m -> FY2024 $19.869m -> FY2025 $22.276m.

base.rationale: Y1 = withdrawn FY26 guidance midpoint 5.82 cps less ~0.32 cps Kiwi Crunch drag (assumes ~half-year effective loss of the 5.8% Hawke's Bay rent before re-let; NZL 75% share ~ $0.97m/yr = 0.66 cps if lost in full). Growth = CPI-linked reviews (61% of leases review in FY26; ~9.5% accumulated CPI on pastoral) fading to CPI. NAV growth 1.0%/yr: modest net revaluations after 90-100% AFFO payout, performance-fee share issuance and discretionary DRP drag (NAV/share was ~flat FY2023-FY2025: 1.602->1.617->1.609). Exit P/B 0.63 = 5.5-year listed-history mean; discount treated as STRUCTURAL.

bull.rationale: Hawke's Bay orchards re-let quickly at comparable rent (early third-party interest cited), withdrawn FY26 guidance midpoint achieved; strong dairy payouts lift land values (NAV +2.5%/yr). Exit P/B 0.74 = the historical MAXIMUM, justified only by a stated catalyst: actual execution of the yield-based buyback under the post-KPMG YieldPlusGrowth framework and/or corporate action (internalisation of the manager, takeover — NZSA has already raised liquidation). Discount closure to 1.0x NOT assumed even in bull.

bear.rationale: Credit contagion: full-year loss of Kiwi Crunch 5.8% rent (-0.66 cps), half-loss of the related Wade Glass-linked 7.3% (Prunus/Consolidated Fruits, -0.41 cps), arrears written off (-0.15 cps) -> Y1 4.60 cps. Dairy payout cut ($9.75->$9.25/kgMS) softens tenant covenants; rural land values fall (NAV -1.5%/yr); refinancing of the 1.4-1.5yr debt book at higher spreads. Exit P/B 0.52, below the 0.557 FY-end minimum, for a credit-impaired story. Payout trimmed to 90% (bottom of policy).

cost_of_equity_build.wacc_rationale: Cost of EQUITY (not WACC): AFFO is post-interest so debt is priced inside the flow. NZD flows discounted at NZD-derived rates. Base 9.25% = NZ 10yr risk-free 4.40% + rural-land asset-class equity premium 3.10% (triple-net CPI-linked land rents are bond-like, land-backed; beta well below 1) + NZX small-cap illiquidity premium 1.00% (mkt cap ~$137m, thin turnover) + tenant-concentration/credit premium 0.50% (nine tenants, live Kiwi Crunch event — the expected LOSS is in the cash flows, this prices residual covenant risk; charged once) + short-debt-tenor refinancing premium 0.25% (1.4-1.5yr weighted term, per Analysis). Market-implied CoE cross-check: trailing attributable AFFO yield 5.81% at $0.935 + ~3% per-share growth ~ 8.8-9.0%, so base CoE sits deliberately ABOVE market-implied. Bull 8.75% (credit premium largely released on re-letting); bear 10.50% (credit premium 1.50%, refi 0.75%).

entry_price.hurdle_note: House 15% hurdle — demanding for an income vehicle; entry prices are correspondingly deep.

required_return_table.note: Less rate-sensitive than a growth DCF because the terminal is anchored to exit P/B x NAV, not a Gordon perpetuity.

sensitivity.axes: rows = cost of equity (%), cols = exit P/B (base-case cash flows and NAV path)

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear elevated to 25% (vs house 15%): a LIVE tenant credit event — Kiwi Crunch receivership, FY26 guidance suspended, and a further ~7.3% of rent with related Wade Glass-linked entities whose wider group is cascading into liquidation. Bull trimmed to 25%: the discount-closure catalysts (buyback execution, internalisation, takeover) are plausible but management's buyback has been dormant through the widest discount, and OIO rules shrink the takeout buyer pool.
probability_weighted.band_note: SBC-zero name: house and street bases coincide, band collapsed — band_position null by convention.

affo_capitalization_cross_check.method: Direct Gordon capitalization of normalized attributable AFFO at CoE
affo_capitalization_cross_check.reconciles: AFFO capitalization ($0.81-0.88) and holding-period model ($0.90) agree within ~7%; the NAV-band cross-check brackets both. The gap to the naive NAV of $1.61 is the structural discount, deliberately NOT assumed to close.

implied_multiples.note: P/E and EV/EBITDA meaningless (IAS 40 revaluation NPAT; no EBITDA concept for a net-lease land trust). AFFO yield and P/B are the relevant multiples.

sanity_check.diagnosis: No trip. Base IV $0.902 implies 0.561x P/B — inside the observed 0.557-0.740 5.5-year band and well below the 0.740 maximum (trip threshold 1.5x max = 1.11x). Bull IV $1.123 implies 0.698x, still inside the band. Base implied trailing AFFO yield 6.02% vs 5.81% at the current price. NZL has NEVER traded above 0.74x book since its Dec-2020 IPO; the SEK.NZ-class error (assuming discount closure to NAV, which would print IV $1.61 / +72%) was designed out ex ante by constraining every exit P/B to the observed band.
sanity_check.fix_applied: None required — constraint applied at construction, not post-hoc.

valuation_philosophy: NZL's 42% discount to NAV is treated as STRUCTURAL, not a mispricing to be harvested. Evidence: (1) the stock has never closed a fiscal year above 0.74x book in 5.5 listed years, including at IPO; (2) the February-2026 KPMG capital review found investors price NZL on cash yield with NAV 'a secondary consideration' — management's own admission the discount will not close on asset-value grounds; (3) external management (0.50% NAV base fee + 1.25% transaction fee + $30k/lease + 10%-of-NAV-growth performance fee, ~$1.93m total FY25 vs $7.9m NPAT) is the classic driver of persistent NAV discounts; (4) OIO farmland screening (retained under the 2025 Amendment Act) shrinks both the asset exit-buyer pool and the corporate takeout pool; (5) the buyback stayed at zero through FY25 despite the widest discount. Therefore the valuation capitalizes the ATTRIBUTABLE cash yield at cost of equity and exits at an in-band P/B: NZL is an income-plus-modest-growth vehicle priced off a ~6% AFFO yield, not an asset play at $1.61. Discount narrowing beyond 0.74x is a bull-catalyst option (buyback execution, manager internalisation, takeover), not a base assumption. The minority is charged exactly once: attributable AFFO (not consolidated) in the flows; NAV already nets the $79.6m LP-unit liability so it is not deducted again.

guidance_status.fy2026_affo_guidance: $8.25m-$8.75m (5.65-5.99 cps) issued Feb-2026, WITHDRAWN July-2026 after Kiwi Crunch receivership
guidance_status.treatment: Base Y1 5.50 cps sits below the 5.65 cps guidance floor; bear 4.60 cps assumes contagion to related Wade Glass entities; bull 5.82 cps = midpoint achieved via rapid re-letting.
